description.value: CrossRoads Tap & Kitchen is the College Heights outpost of CrossRoads Brewing & Distillery, a Prince George craft brewery and distillery that opened this location in 2022 after its beloved downtown home — a restored 1946 garage building — was destroyed by fire. The brewery draws its name and identity from Prince George's position as BC's geographic crossroads, at the junction of Highways 16 and 97 and the confluence of the Nechako and Fraser rivers. Touring cyclists passing through on either major route will find a full kitchen menu, house-brewed craft beer, and online ordering for delivery.

address.value: 5224 Domano Boulevard, Prince George, BC V2N 4A1
